about.text: Switzerland’s lighter soured cream, at least 15 % fat; its full soured cream is sold as crème fraîche, at least 35 %.

links.name: Swissmilk: Crème fraîche, Kaffeerahm und Co.

how.text: Swiss half cream (Halbrahm) is pasteurised and lightly soured with lactic acid bacteria. Swissmilk names no species, temperatures or times.
